_meta.note: 一个任务一个文件。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

The Scarred Springs#000.src: Talk to Maripe at Pishlas at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Scarred Springs#000.dst: 在 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Pishlas 与 Maripe 交谈。

The Scarred Springs#001.src: Oh! Well, hello there, tourist! I have to assume you're a tourist, anyways. That doesn't look like local dress, anyways. I suppose you've heard about the hot springs!
The Scarred Springs#001.dst: 噢！嗯，你好啊，游客！反正我猜你是游客。那身打扮看起来不像本地人。我想你是听说了这里的温泉吧！
The Scarred Springs#001.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#002.src: Well, ah...unfortunately, Pishlas is closed for renovations. You see, it's been closed for a long time... My family has run it for generations, but trouble started.
The Scarred Springs#002.dst: 嗯，啊……可惜 Pishlas 正在整修，暂停营业。你看，它已经关了很久了……我们家经营这里好几代了，可是后来出了问题。
The Scarred Springs#002.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#003.src: With my mother having been stricken ill for so long, my father and all our family, we've had to abandon this place to care for her. It's fallen into disrepair.
The Scarred Springs#003.dst: 我妈妈病了好长一段时间，我爸爸和全家人只好丢下这里去照顾她。结果这里就荒废了。
The Scarred Springs#003.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#004.src: She's well enough now that she doesn't need someone looking after her every hour, so I'm taking it on myself to return this place to its former glory!
The Scarred Springs#004.dst: 她现在好多了，不需要人时时刻刻照顾，所以我决定自己来让这里恢复往日的风光！
The Scarred Springs#004.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#005.src: It's been hard work...and it should be opening soon- but I'm not quite done. Again, I'm so sorry you came all this way for nothing.
The Scarred Springs#005.dst: 这工作很辛苦……应该很快就能开张了——不过我还没完全弄完。再说一次，真抱歉让你白跑一趟。
The Scarred Springs#005.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#006.src: I- excuse me? You want to...
The Scarred Springs#006.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#007.src: That'd... That'd be absolutely fantastic!! I've been working alone on this for months now!! I'm NEARLY done, but-
The Scarred Springs#007.dst: 那……那真是太棒了！！我一个人弄这个已经好几个月了！！我快弄完了，可是——
The Scarred Springs#007.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#008.src: Come on, come on! I'll show you around! Let's go, let's go!!
The Scarred Springs#008.dst: 来吧，来吧！我带你四处看看！走吧，走吧！！
The Scarred Springs#008.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#009.src: Hopefully you'll be able to visit before you have to go home then!
The Scarred Springs#009.dst: 希望你回家之前还有机会来玩！
The Scarred Springs#009.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#010.src: Okay, okay, what's next on the list... C'mon, think like Sovereign Zhiraok!
The Scarred Springs#010.dst: 好，好，清单上下一件是什么……加油，像 Zhiraok 统领那样思考！
The Scarred Springs#010.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#011.src: Let Maripe show you around at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Scarred Springs#011.dst: 让 Maripe 带你在 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 四处看看。

The Scarred Springs#012.src: Okay, so! These are the main pools- Frankly, I have no idea how all these frogs got here, given the bog is clear across the whole forest...
The Scarred Springs#012.dst: 好，那么！这些是主池——说真的，我完全不知道这些青蛙是怎么跑来的，沼泽明明在整片森林的另一头……
The Scarred Springs#012.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#013.src: But they've got to go. Sure, they're cute, but no one's going to want to take a soak with them... Or with all these fallen leaves in the pools.
The Scarred Springs#013.dst: 不过它们得离开。当然，它们很可爱，可没人会想跟它们一起泡……也不会想跟池子里这些落叶一起泡。
The Scarred Springs#013.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#014.src: The side pool over here is just as important to clean out. Need to have clear pools for the guests! And maybe even for the Sovereign!
The Scarred Springs#014.dst: 这边的侧池也一样得清干净。池子得干干净净的才能招待客人！说不定连统领都会来！
The Scarred Springs#014.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#015.src: I've already put a lot of time into fixing up these huts. I do carpentry work. These used to be in so much worse shape... I'm a little glad my grandparents didn't end up seeing it like this.
The Scarred Springs#015.dst: 我已经花了很多时间修这些小屋。我是做木工的。这些以前破得多了……我爷爷奶奶没看到它变成这副模样，我倒是有点庆幸。
The Scarred Springs#015.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#016.src: I have such fond memories of playing around here when I was younger... What would they think, seeing it fall apart? That thought has been giving me motivation this whole time.
The Scarred Springs#016.dst: 我小时候在这附近玩的回忆好美好……他们要是看到这里破败成这样，会怎么想？这个念头一直是我的动力。
The Scarred Springs#016.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#017.src: It'd be a disgrace to let Pishlas fall completely apart. Even Sovereign Zhiraok agreed! Did you know he dropped by, when I was first starting- Oh, wait! There's one other place!
The Scarred Springs#017.dst: 要是让 Pishlas 彻底垮掉，那可就太丢脸了。连 Zhiraok 统领都同意！你知道吗，我刚开始动工的时候他来过——噢，等等！还有一个地方！
The Scarred Springs#017.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#018.src: The teahouse! Refreshments, hot drinks, a place to sit out of the water... This is one of the big remaining projects. I'll take care of this- but, back about the Sovereign?
The Scarred Springs#018.dst: 茶馆！茶点、热饮，还有个离开水面坐坐的地方……这是剩下的大工程之一。这个我来负责——不过，回到统领的事？
The Scarred Springs#018.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#019.src: He visited one day, while I was starting on fixing the place, and he told me this would be a fantastic community service! Since it's been so long since Pishlas has been usable, I mean.
The Scarred Springs#019.dst: 我开始修这里的时候，他某天来过，还跟我说这会是件很棒的社区服务！毕竟 Pishlas 已经很久没法使用了。
The Scarred Springs#019.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#020.src: This used to be a big community center. Losing it was a blow to all Auburn residents... He's promised some great things if I can clean this all up! So let's get to it!
The Scarred Springs#020.dst: 这里以前是很重要的社区中心。失去它对所有 Auburn 居民都是个打击……他答应，只要我能把这里整顿好，就会有很棒的奖励！所以我们开工吧！
The Scarred Springs#020.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#021.src: You go gather up the frogs! There's a pond to the you can drop them off at. Then...the leaves! Pick them out of the pools. Then...then come back and we'll see where we're at!
The Scarred Springs#021.dst: 你去把青蛙抓起来！那边有个池塘可以把它们放掉。然后……叶子！把池子里的叶子捞出来。然后……然后回来，我们看看进度到哪了！
The Scarred Springs#021.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#023.src: How's it coming? Still working on this. Will be for a bit, but I'm energized! Maybe I can get this done today, even! Uh...right, right! Frogs!
The Scarred Springs#023.dst: 进行得怎么样？我这边还在弄。还要一阵子，不过我干劲十足！说不定今天就能弄完！呃……对，对！青蛙！
The Scarred Springs#023.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#024.src: Okay, there were five, and you're holding... Alright, so there's left to get!
The Scarred Springs#024.dst: 好，一共有五只，你手上拿着……好，那还剩几只要抓！
The Scarred Springs#024.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#025.src: Release the frogs at the pond in the back at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Scarred Springs#026.src: Woah! That...that's sure a way to carry the frogs, haha! Y- Pfffkhhhaaahahahaa!! You look- Wahaha, that's fantastic!! Oh, Ohhkay, okay, right!
The Scarred Springs#026.dst: 哇！那……那可真是种抓青蛙的方式，哈哈！你——噗哈哈哈哈哈！！你看起来——哇哈哈，太棒了！！噢，好好好，对！
The Scarred Springs#026.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#027.src: There's a pond to the of Pishlas here you can drop them off at! Now, g-get out of here, eheheh! I gotta concentrate, and there's frogs on y- heehehahahahaaah!!
The Scarred Springs#027.dst: Pishlas 这边有个池塘可以把它们放掉！好了，快、快走吧，嘿嘿嘿！我得专心，而你身上还有青蛙——嘻嘻哈哈哈哈哈！！
The Scarred Springs#027.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#028.src: Pick up all the leaf piles around [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Scarred Springs#029.src: Okay, frogs are dealt with, now the leaves! There were ten big patches out there I saw. Get in there and scoop them up- Uh, lemme see. ...
The Scarred Springs#029.dst: 好，青蛙解决了，现在是叶子！我看到外面有十大片。去把它们捞起来——呃，我看看。……
The Scarred Springs#029.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#030.src: Okay, you got left! Hopefully once you do, I'll be all done over here, and we'll go from there!
The Scarred Springs#030.dst: 好，还剩几片！希望等你弄完，我这边也全都弄好了，我们再看下一步！
The Scarred Springs#030.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#032.src: Okay, there! And STAY in, you darn board... So, how's the work going?
The Scarred Springs#032.dst: 好，搞定！给我乖乖钉着，你这块该死的木板……那么，工作进行得怎么样？
The Scarred Springs#032.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#033.src: Frogs dealt with, check...and leaves out of the water, check! Which, ah...well, that means now I need you to get some leaves...to put IN the water, eheh!
The Scarred Springs#033.dst: 青蛙解决了，打勾……叶子捞出水面，打勾！这就，呃……嗯，意味着现在我需要你去弄些叶子……放进水里，嘿嘿！
The Scarred Springs#033.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#034.src: What I mean by that, is that I need fresh tea for the teahouse! I've already got some food stowed away for refreshments, but I'll need some drinks to go along with that.
The Scarred Springs#034.dst: 我的意思是，我需要给茶馆弄些新鲜的茶叶！茶点的食物我已经准备好了，但还需要搭配的饮料。
The Scarred Springs#034.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#035.src: I might be done in this building, but there's still plenty of things for me to take care of, so I've got to stay behind and really...really focus in on this!
The Scarred Springs#035.dst: 这栋房子我可能弄完了，但还有很多事要处理，所以我得留下来，真的……真的得专心弄这个！
The Scarred Springs#035.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#036.src: It's just that...a lot of this isn't heavy work, but there's just so many tasks on the list that I don't know where to start, so I just can't get it going. You taking care of the other things is helping with that!
The Scarred Springs#036.dst: 只是……这些大多不是什么粗活，可清单上的事实在太多，我不知道从哪里开始，结果就是动不起来。你帮我处理其他事，真的帮了大忙！
The Scarred Springs#036.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#037.src: So, uh, anyway! There's a teahouse off to the northwest, up on a ridge. I know the owner- her name's Marseled, and she makes the best tea in the whole forest!
The Scarred Springs#037.dst: 所以，呃，总之！西北边的山脊上有家茶馆。我认识老板——她叫 Marseled，泡的茶是整片森林最好的！
The Scarred Springs#037.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#038.src: So, your job is to head there for a big bulk order, and then bring it back! I'll ask her about paying it off later, since we trade favors a lot. Tell her I sent you!
The Scarred Springs#038.dst: 所以，你的工作是去那里下一大笔订单，然后带回来！钱的事我之后再跟她谈，我们常常互相帮忙。告诉她是我叫你去的！
The Scarred Springs#038.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#040.src: Okay, dust busted, cobwebs cleared, lanterns in the middle of being lit- Oh, hey! Did you get the tea?
The Scarred Springs#040.dst: 好，灰尘扫了，蜘蛛网清了，灯笼正点到一半——噢，嘿！茶叶拿到了吗？
The Scarred Springs#040.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#041.src: Marseled's teahouse is off to the northwest, up on the ridge. If you need the exact spot, look in your !
The Scarred Springs#041.dst: Marseled 的茶馆在西北边的山脊上。需要确切位置的话，就看看你的内容手册！
The Scarred Springs#041.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#042.src: Welcome, traveler, to my humble teahouse. My name is Marseled. It is always a pleasure to see a new customer.
The Scarred Springs#042.dst: 欢迎来到我简陋的茶馆，旅人。我叫 Marseled。能见到新客人总是件乐事。
The Scarred Springs#042.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#043.src: So, what can I do for you?
The Scarred Springs#043.dst: 那么，有什么能为你效劳的？
The Scarred Springs#043.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#044.src: Oh, is that so? Why, that's wonderful! He's spoken with me a few times about working on old Pishlas there. If he wants fresh stock for drinks, he must be confident that it's nearly finished!
The Scarred Springs#044.dst: 噢，是这样吗？哎呀，那真是太好了！他跟我提过好几次在整修老 Pishlas 的事。既然他要新鲜的饮品货源，一定是很有把握快完工了！
The Scarred Springs#044.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#045.src: Admittedly, though, I'm facing some...difficulties. I've not got quite enough to fill up an order like he'll need. You see, ah...there's...
The Scarred Springs#045.dst: 不过，老实说，我遇到了一些……困难。我手上的量不太够他要的那种订单。你看，呃……有……
The Scarred Springs#045.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#046.src: It's COCKROACHES! Filthy, ugly, disgusting COCKROACHES!! They keep getting all over the mushrooms and on the tea leaves and I CAN'T touch them, I can't I can't I CAN'T!!
The Scarred Springs#046.dst: 是蟑螂！又脏又丑又恶心的蟑螂！！它们老是爬满蘑菇和茶叶，我不敢碰它们，我不敢不敢不敢！！
The Scarred Springs#046.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#047.src: They aren't even harming the plants or anything, but I go out to harvest them and they race up to me and crawl all over my feet and up my leggings and aahghguhgughuguhhhh!!!
The Scarred Springs#047.dst: 它们甚至没伤害植物什么的，可我一出去采收，它们就冲过来爬满我的脚，还爬进我的裤管里，啊啊呃呃呃呃呃呃！！！
The Scarred Springs#047.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#048.src: I hate them I hate them I hate them, I hate them so much! I- Er. Um. S-sorry. I...shouldn't act so ill-mannered in front of my customers.
The Scarred Springs#048.dst: 我讨厌它们我讨厌它们我讨厌它们，我超级讨厌它们！我——呃。嗯。抱、抱歉。我……不该在客人面前这么失态。
The Scarred Springs#048.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#049.src: The musrooms are right out front and the leaves are down the side of the hill. and should be enough to get me started again.
The Scarred Springs#049.dst: 蘑菇就在门口，茶叶在山坡下面。这些应该够我重新开工。
The Scarred Springs#049.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#050.src: I do hate to ask, but...if you could go out and harvest some of the ingredients for me? And deal with the pests? I've tried, but every time I just...panic.
The Scarred Springs#050.dst: 我实在不好意思开口，但是……你能不能出去帮我采些材料？顺便对付那些害虫？我试过了，可每次都……慌得不行。
The Scarred Springs#050.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#051.src: If you could take care of that problem for me, I'll be able to fill out the order for Maripe... And, hopefully, I won't wake the whole of {p} shrieking over a roach in my pants.
The Scarred Springs#051.dst: 如果你能帮我解决这个问题，我就能把 Maripe 的订单做出来……而且，希望我不会因为裤子里有蟑螂尖叫到把整个 {p} 吵醒。
The Scarred Springs#051.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#052.src: The mushrooms are just out front, and the leaves are down the side of the hill. and should be enough to fill the order.
The Scarred Springs#052.dst: 蘑菇就在门口，茶叶在山坡下面。这些应该够做那张订单。
The Scarred Springs#052.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#053.src: Collect {~} mushrooms and {~} leaf batches from the tea farm at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Scarred Springs#054.src: Oh, hey! Did you get the tea yet? I'm trying to get everything in ship-shape here, but I'm running in circles a little...
The Scarred Springs#054.dst: 噢，嘿！茶叶拿到了吗？我正想把这里的一切都弄得井井有条，可我有点在原地打转……
The Scarred Springs#054.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#055.src: Oh, ew. She's got roaches in the farm? Yeah, that's rough. Anyways, go get 'em! I'll be, uh... Well, hopefully I'll have this done by the time you deal with that!
The Scarred Springs#055.dst: 噢，恶。她的茶园有蟑螂？是啊，那可不好受。总之，去对付它们吧！我会，呃……嗯，希望等你解决那些东西的时候，我这边已经弄完了！
The Scarred Springs#055.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#056.src: Bring the tea you collected back to Marseled at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Scarred Springs#056.dst: 把你收集的茶叶带回给 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Marseled。

The Scarred Springs#057.src: So, what can I do for you?
The Scarred Springs#057.dst: 那么，有什么能为你效劳的？
The Scarred Springs#057.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#059.src: YES!! Take THAT, you dirty things! No more cockroooaches, no more cockroooaches, yeah, yeah- Er!
The Scarred Springs#059.dst: 太好了！！看招吧，你们这些脏东西！再也没有蟑～螂～了，再也没有蟑～螂～了，耶，耶——呃！
The Scarred Springs#059.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#060.src: ...if you could. Um. Not tell anyone I was...doing that happy dance. Please. I don't think I've done that since I was a child.
The Scarred Springs#060.dst: ……可以的话。嗯。别告诉任何人我……在跳那支开心舞。拜托。我想我从小时候之后就没跳过了。
The Scarred Springs#060.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#061.src: A-anyway, I'll pack up that order and bring it down to Pishlas on my own time. I know where it is. Perhaps I can be there for the opening celebrations, too!
The Scarred Springs#061.dst: 总、总之，我会把订单打包好，找时间自己送去 Pishlas。我知道在哪。说不定我还能赶上开幕庆祝！
The Scarred Springs#061.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#062.src: I'll be sure to let my customers know. An entire generation has missed out on those hot springs, if my parents speak truly, so this will be an event to cherish, I think!
The Scarred Springs#062.dst: 我一定会告诉我的客人。要是我爸妈说的没错，一整代人都错过了那座温泉，所以我想这会是个值得珍惜的盛事！
The Scarred Springs#062.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#063.src: Okay, that's that now, so now- Oh, you're back! Did you get the order all filled out?
The Scarred Springs#063.dst: 好，那个弄完了，那现在——噢，你回来了！订单都下好了吗？
The Scarred Springs#063.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#064.src: ...oops. You got confused, didn't you. Nah, those ingredients need to go to Marseled, and THEN come here. Good hustle, though! Get those to Marseled for processing!
The Scarred Springs#064.dst: ……哎呀。你搞混了，对吧。不对，那些材料要先送去给 Marseled，然后才送来这里。不过你挺卖力的！把那些拿去给 Marseled 加工吧！
The Scarred Springs#064.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#065.src: Bring the tea back to Maripe at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Scarred Springs#065.dst: 把茶叶带回给 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Maripe。

The Scarred Springs#066.src: Oh my gosh, oh my gosh...L-Look! We have visitors!! Um, I know I'm not setting a great example, but...be quiet, okay? Don't disturb them!
The Scarred Springs#066.dst: 天啊，天啊……看、看！有访客！！呃，我知道我没做好榜样，不过……小声点，好吗？别打扰它们！
The Scarred Springs#066.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#067.src: See? The foxes...! I haven't seen them around here since I was a kid! I- well, if you're a tourist you wouldn't know, I suppose, but this is exciting!
The Scarred Springs#067.dst: 看到了吗？狐狸……！我从小时候之后就没在这附近见过它们了！我——嗯，如果你是游客，大概不知道吧，不过这真令人兴奋！
The Scarred Springs#067.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#068.src: There's a really common tale about foxes here- That they're the reincarnation of our ancestors, that their spirits inhabit them. I know it's...well, it's supposed to be just a tall tale, but...
The Scarred Springs#068.dst: 这里有个很普遍的狐狸传说——说它们是我们祖先转世，祖先的灵魂住在它们身上。我知道那……嗯，应该只是个传说而已，可是……
The Scarred Springs#068.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#069.src: I really can't help but feel like seeing them here is a good omen! It's like my grandparents are back again- Er, wait! The tea! I completely forgot, did you get the order placed?
The Scarred Springs#069.dst: 我还是忍不住觉得在这里看到它们是个好兆头！就像我爷爷奶奶又回来了——呃，等等！茶叶！我完全忘了，订单下好了吗？
The Scarred Springs#069.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#070.src: Oh, Marseled said she'd bring it by herself? Alright, fantastic! And she said she'd invite folks to the opening too... Funny she did, since that's what I was just about to ask you to do!
The Scarred Springs#070.dst: 噢，Marseled 说她会自己送来？好，太好了！她还说会邀请大家来开幕……真巧，我正要请你去做这件事！
The Scarred Springs#070.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#071.src: Pishlas is almost back to the way I remember it being when I was younger. I've still got a bit of decorating to do, so I want you to spread the word!
The Scarred Springs#071.dst: Pishlas 快恢复成我小时候记忆中的样子了。我还有点装饰要弄，所以想请你帮我把消息传出去！
The Scarred Springs#071.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#072.src: I've got some notes here on where you could find folks I know in {p}. You tell them, put some notices up...
The Scarred Springs#072.dst: 我这里有些笔记，写着在 {p} 哪里能找到我认识的人。你去告诉他们，贴几张告示……
The Scarred Springs#072.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#073.src: ...and then after the big celebration re-opening, they'll tell their families, and then word will spread from there! Is it odd to say I'm looking forward to the work of maintaining the place?
The Scarred Springs#073.dst: ……然后等盛大的重新开幕庆祝之后，他们会告诉家人，消息就会从那里传开！说我很期待之后维护这地方的工作，会不会很奇怪？
The Scarred Springs#073.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#074.src: Anyways, head off and start getting the word out! If you don't know where to look, just ! If you lose my notes you can come back and I'll copy them down again for you.
The Scarred Springs#074.dst: 总之，出发去把消息传出去吧！不知道去哪找的话，就看看内容手册！要是把我的笔记弄丢了，可以回来，我再帮你抄一份。
The Scarred Springs#074.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#075.src: Invite citizens of {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to join the opening celebrations.
The Scarred Springs#075.dst: 邀请 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 {p} 居民参加开幕庆祝。

The Scarred Springs#076.src: Whew, okay... Whew. Gotta remember, I'm not the Sovereign. Can't be everywhere at once. Need to slow down...it's nearly done, no need to stress out- Oh, hey!
The Scarred Springs#076.dst: 呼，好……呼。得记住，我不是统领。不可能同时出现在每个地方。得慢下来……快弄完了，没必要紧张——噢，嘿！
The Scarred Springs#076.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#077.src: Have you spread the word yet? to see where the people usually are, and get the news out! You're invited to the grand re-opening too, of course.
The Scarred Springs#077.dst: 消息传出去了吗？看看内容手册里大家平常在哪，把消息告诉他们！当然，你也受邀参加盛大的重新开幕。
The Scarred Springs#077.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#078.src: Whew, okay... Whew. Gotta remember, I'm not the Sovereign. Can't be everywhere at once. Need to slow down...it's nearly done, no need to stress out- Oh, hey!
The Scarred Springs#078.dst: 呼，好……呼。得记住，我不是统领。不可能同时出现在每个地方。得慢下来……快弄完了，没必要紧张——噢，嘿！
The Scarred Springs#078.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#079.src: Oh, you lost my notes. Don't worry, it happens. Do you think you can find the spots on your own, or do you want me to write a new copy down for you?
The Scarred Springs#079.dst: 噢，你把我的笔记弄丢了。别担心，这种事难免。你觉得自己找得到那些地方吗，还是要我帮你重新写一份？
The Scarred Springs#079.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#080.src: Okay, one sec...and...here! Remember to for where to go!
The Scarred Springs#080.dst: 好，等一下……然后……给你！记得看内容手册找要去哪里！
The Scarred Springs#080.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#081.src: All the spots I listed are , but if you're having trouble, I'll write you up a new set if you ask!
The Scarred Springs#081.dst: 我列的地方都在内容手册里，不过如果你找不到，跟我说一声，我再帮你写一份新的！
The Scarred Springs#081.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#082.src: Oh, hello there. I certainly haven't seen you around here before.
The Scarred Springs#082.dst: 噢，你好。我肯定没在这附近见过你。
The Scarred Springs#082.speaker: Cousullo

The Scarred Springs#083.src: Is there something you wanted to speak with me about?
The Scarred Springs#083.speaker: Cousullo

The Scarred Springs#084.dst: 什、什么？什么快要重新开张了？
The Scarred Springs#084.speaker: Cousullo

The Scarred Springs#085.src: Oh, OH! Pishlas? The hot springs? Sorry, it's been so long that I nearly forgot the name.
The Scarred Springs#085.dst: 噢，噢！Pishlas？那座温泉？抱歉，太久了，我差点把名字都忘了。
The Scarred Springs#085.speaker: Cousullo

The Scarred Springs#086.src: I have such vague memories of going there as a child, but I couldn't imagine them after seeing how the place was abandoned.
The Scarred Springs#086.dst: 我对小时候去那里只有很模糊的记忆，看到那地方荒废之后，我实在想象不出它原来的样子。
The Scarred Springs#086.speaker: Cousullo

The Scarred Springs#087.src: Maripe did tell me some time ago he would be working on renovating it. I'm to suppose his work has paid off, then! I'd intended to visit him again soon, but this provides a nice excuse, as well.
The Scarred Springs#087.dst: Maripe 之前确实跟我说过他在整修那里。看来他的努力有了回报！我本来就打算最近再去看看他，这下正好有个好借口。
The Scarred Springs#087.speaker: Cousullo

The Scarred Springs#088.src: ...I might have to spread the word to his family for him. Even if Maripe's father is too busy looking after his wife, I'm sure he'll be delighted to hear about this.
The Scarred Springs#088.dst: ……我也许得替他把消息告诉他的家人。就算 Maripe 的爸爸忙着照顾他妻子，我相信他听到这件事也会很高兴的。
The Scarred Springs#088.speaker: Cousullo

The Scarred Springs#089.src: Well, I hope to see you there, stranger!
The Scarred Springs#089.dst: 好了，希望在那里见到你，陌生人！
The Scarred Springs#089.speaker: Cousullo

The Scarred Springs#090.src: Well, this is a sight, for sure! What can we do for you, fella?
The Scarred Springs#090.dst: 嗯，这可真是难得一见！有什么我们能为你做的吗，伙计？
The Scarred Springs#090.speaker: Mont

The Scarred Springs#092.src: It's been ages, right...? That place, it's been in a state of disrepair for as long as I can recall...
The Scarred Springs#092.dst: 已经好久了，对吧……？那地方，从我有记忆以来就一直是荒废的……
The Scarred Springs#092.speaker: Nerod

The Scarred Springs#093.src: They're finally going to be open again? And fully renovated? Sounds-
The Scarred Springs#093.dst: 终于要重新开放了？还整修得焕然一新？听起来——
The Scarred Springs#093.speaker: Mont

The Scarred Springs#094.src: Sounds tempting. It's been ages since I've been able to bathe in hot water or relax properly...
The Scarred Springs#094.dst: 听起来很诱人。我已经好久没能泡个热水澡、好好放松一下了……
The Scarred Springs#094.speaker: Feri

The Scarred Springs#095.src: We'll surely all be there! These old bones could use a nice, long soak, I think!
The Scarred Springs#095.dst: 我们肯定都会去！我想我这把老骨头正需要好好泡个够！
The Scarred Springs#095.speaker: Mont

The Scarred Springs#096.src: The tourist returns! Anything else you wanted to talk about?
The Scarred Springs#096.dst: 游客又来了！还有什么想聊的吗？
The Scarred Springs#096.speaker: Mont

The Scarred Springs#097.src: Head back to Pishlas to participate in the celebrations at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Scarred Springs#097.dst: 回到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Pishlas 参加庆祝。

The Scarred Springs#098.src: Okay. Phew. Wow. Okay. Alright, alright, it's...
The Scarred Springs#098.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#099.src: It's...it's done. It's all... It's all done, wow, I... There's. There's people... And they're here, and they're enjoying it, and, and...
The Scarred Springs#099.dst: 这……弄完了。全都……全都弄完了，哇，我……那里。那里有人……他们来了，他们玩得很开心，而且，而且……
The Scarred Springs#099.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#100.src: And I don't have to think about this anymore, and my parents can relax about having let the place go, and...
The Scarred Springs#100.dst: 而且我再也不用想这件事了，我爸妈也不用再为放着这地方不管而内疚了，而且……
The Scarred Springs#100.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#101.src: And, and, and, the, the Sovereign, he'll, Ill get to tell him I'm done, and I'll get that, and... Ohhh my stars I'm done but I'm even more anxious now that it's done than I was before, aaah-
The Scarred Springs#101.dst: 而且、而且、而且，统、统领，他会，我可以告诉他我弄完了，然后我就能拿到那个，而且……噢天啊我弄完了，可弄完之后我反而比之前更紧张了，啊啊——
The Scarred Springs#101.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#102.src: Okay, come on, keep your head on straight, Maripe! Now's the time to relax a bit... Deep breaths now- Oh, hey!
The Scarred Springs#102.dst: 好，振作点，冷静下来，Maripe！现在是该放松一下的时候……深呼吸——噢，嘿！
The Scarred Springs#102.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#103.src: Uh, I...I need a minute, eheh. How about...you, uh, talk to everyone else, first, and just...yeah?
The Scarred Springs#103.dst: 呃，我……我需要一点时间，嘿嘿。不如……你，呃，先去跟其他人聊聊，然后……好吗？
The Scarred Springs#103.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#104.src: I'd say I barely recognize the place after all the renovations...but honestly, it feels like I'm right at home, like I'm that little fox kit I used to be.
The Scarred Springs#104.dst: 要我说，整修之后我几乎认不出这地方了……但说真的，感觉就像回到家一样，就像我还是以前那只小狐狸崽。
The Scarred Springs#104.speaker: Cousullo

The Scarred Springs#105.src: Maripe tried to talk you up like you did all the work! I practically had to pry a confession out of him that you just came in at the end to help with the finishing touches.
The Scarred Springs#105.dst: Maripe 想把功劳都往你身上推，说得好像全是你做的！我几乎是硬逼他才承认，你只是最后才来帮忙收尾。
The Scarred Springs#105.speaker: Cousullo

The Scarred Springs#106.src: He's always been a humble sort, but I think that just shows his gratitude. And believe me, I'm grateful to you as well! I think you gave him the kick he needed.
The Scarred Springs#106.dst: 他一直都是个谦虚的人，不过我想那正显示了他的感激。相信我，我也很感激你！我想是你推了他最需要的那一把。
The Scarred Springs#106.speaker: Cousullo

The Scarred Springs#107.src: Ohhhohoho that's the spot. Man...I never knew what I was missing. Sort of an old style name, Pishlas, but...
The Scarred Springs#107.dst: 噢噢噢呵呵呵，就是这里。天啊……我从来不知道自己错过了什么。Pishlas，名字有点老派，不过……
The Scarred Springs#107.speaker: Denis

The Scarred Springs#108.src: Phew, I'm definitely going to be coming back here again. A long day of Liff hunting, then a long night's soak... Oh, that sounds like a satisfying routine...
The Scarred Springs#108.dst: 呼，我肯定还会再来的。白天猎一整天 Liff，晚上再好好泡个够……噢，听起来真是令人满足的日常……
The Scarred Springs#108.speaker: Denis

The Scarred Springs#109.src: Maripe, hm. That boy has done good. Certainly couldn't have done better myself, at my age. He's got an eye for carpentry, for decoration, for the respect of his ancestors...
The Scarred Springs#109.dst: Maripe，嗯。那孩子干得好。换作我这把年纪，肯定做不得更好。他有木工的眼光、装饰的品味，也懂得尊敬祖先……
The Scarred Springs#109.speaker: Feri

The Scarred Springs#110.src: And heck, he's even got free towels provided! I'll be a regular from now on, that's for sure! Hope he's prepared for daily business!
The Scarred Springs#110.dst: 而且，天啊，他还免费提供毛巾！以后我肯定是常客了！希望他准备好天天营业！
The Scarred Springs#110.speaker: Feri

The Scarred Springs#111.src: Wow... I'll have to tell Timot what he's missing out on. This is fantastic. Perfect view, perfect water, perfect service...
The Scarred Springs#111.dst: 哇……我得告诉 Timot 他错过了什么。这里太棒了。完美的景色、完美的泉水、完美的服务……
The Scarred Springs#111.speaker: Nerod

The Scarred Springs#112.src: Family concerns are dfinitely more important than a warm bath, but... I'll have to share some leaves with him, buy his ticket for next time. He deserves a free soak.
The Scarred Springs#112.dst: 家里的事当然比泡热水澡重要，不过……我得分他一些茶叶，下次帮他买张票。他值得免费泡一次。
The Scarred Springs#112.speaker: Nerod

The Scarred Springs#113.src: Ahhh, that hits the spot... Youngster, do yourself a favor- never get as old as I am. {~} years, I've got...and this... Goodbye, aches, my dear old enemies...
The Scarred Springs#113.dst: 啊……真舒服……年轻人，帮自己个忙——千万别老到像我这样。我都 {~} 岁了……而这个……再见了，酸痛，我亲爱的老冤家……
The Scarred Springs#113.speaker: Mont

The Scarred Springs#114.src: It's heavenly to feel them wash away in the water, but boy would I love to not creak when I sit down to begin with. Good on you for helping out, by the way- especially for a tourist!
The Scarred Springs#114.dst: 感觉它们在水里被冲走真是太美妙了，可我更希望坐下的时候骨头别嘎吱响。对了，你来帮忙真是好样的——尤其你还是个游客！
The Scarred Springs#114.speaker: Mont

The Scarred Springs#115.src: After the community notice board got vandalized so badly a couple years ago, I thought not to trust it again. I'm quite glad I broke with that and gave it a look now.
The Scarred Springs#115.dst: 几年前社区布告栏被破坏得那么严重之后，我就不太敢再相信它了。现在我很庆幸自己破了这个例，去看了一眼。
The Scarred Springs#115.speaker: Fiscu

The Scarred Springs#116.src: Have you seen the owner of the springs, by the way? He's had a few foxes around him all day- normally, they're not the ones doing the chasing like that!
The Scarred Springs#116.dst: 对了，你看到温泉的老板了吗？一整天都有几只狐狸跟在他身边——平常可不是它们去追人啊！
The Scarred Springs#116.speaker: Fiscu

The Scarred Springs#117.src: Oh, it's lovely to be back. Having visited this place as a teenager, it had always saddened me that it closed. My heart really does go out to Maripe's mother.
The Scarred Springs#117.dst: 噢，能回来真好。我十几岁的时候来过这里，它关门一直让我很难过。我真的很同情 Maripe 的妈妈。
The Scarred Springs#117.speaker: Estur

The Scarred Springs#118.src: Honestly, if the Sovereign can manage all his business, his father should've been able to keep up. But either way, Maripe has outdone himself- and the Auburn Amaretto is such a fine vintage!
The Scarred Springs#118.dst: 说真的，如果统领能把他所有的事都处理好，他爸爸应该也能撑下来才对。不过不管怎样，Maripe 这次超越了自己——而且 Auburn 杏仁酒真是上等的佳酿！
The Scarred Springs#118.speaker: Estur

The Scarred Springs#119.src: I've enough years on me to remember how Maripe's grandparents used to run this place. Maripe has outdone himself- this is, at barest minimum, up to their standard. No one can say otherwise.
The Scarred Springs#119.dst: 我年纪够大，还记得 Maripe 的爷爷奶奶是怎么经营这里的。Maripe 这次超越了自己——这里至少达到了他们当年的水准。没人能说不是。
The Scarred Springs#119.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#120.src: It always was something of a...blemish, on his family's name, this place. I understand his mother fell ill, and that's certainly no one's fault, but abandoning a family business for any reason...
The Scarred Springs#120.dst: 这个地方一直有点像是……他们家名声上的污点。我明白他妈妈是生病了，那当然不是任何人的错，可是不管什么理由放弃家族生意……
The Scarred Springs#120.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#121.src: People judged them all, whether they realized it or not. Hopefully now with Pishlas open, that will end. It feels as if a cloud has lifted, really. Hmhm, or maybe that's just the tea.
The Scarred Springs#121.dst: 不管大家有没有意识到，人们都在评判他们。希望现在 Pishlas 开张了，这件事能就此结束。说真的，感觉就像乌云散去了。呵呵，或者只是茶的缘故吧。
The Scarred Springs#121.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#122.src: Either way, this is marvelous work. And I can take my harvest without having to worry about disgusting cockroaches crawling all over me! So thank you for that, as well.
The Scarred Springs#122.dst: 总之，这真是出色的工作。而且我现在采收的时候不用担心恶心的蟑螂爬满全身了！所以这点也谢谢你。
The Scarred Springs#122.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#123.dst: 与 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Maripe 交谈

The Scarred Springs#124.src: I think I said earlier- with so many different little things piling up, I just couldn't think straight. i've been stuck at 'almost done' for a while now.
The Scarred Springs#124.dst: 我想我之前说过——一堆零零碎碎的小事堆起来，我根本没法好好思考。我卡在“快弄完了”这个阶段已经好一阵子了。
The Scarred Springs#124.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#125.src: You showing up, offering to take care of all the little things cluttering up my brainspace...that made this...possible! I don't think I could've done it without you!
The Scarred Springs#125.dst: 你出现了，还主动帮我处理那些塞满我脑袋的小事……这才让这一切……成为可能！我想没有你我办不到！
The Scarred Springs#125.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#126.src: It really is jsut like I remembered it being. Everyone getting together and relaxing, talking about whatever strikes their fancy, just letting their woes disappear...
The Scarred Springs#126.dst: 这里真的就跟我记忆中的一样。大家聚在一起放松，想聊什么就聊什么，就这样让烦恼消失……
The Scarred Springs#126.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#127.src: It even feels like I've got my grandparents right here with me. ...though, maybe that's just these two. These foxes have been following me all day...I hope they'll stick around.
The Scarred Springs#127.dst: 甚至感觉就像我爷爷奶奶就在我身边。……不过，也许只是因为这两只吧。这些狐狸跟了我一整天……希望它们会留下来。
The Scarred Springs#127.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#128.src: It's this feeling of... a weight off my chest, but the knowledge there's a new task ahead of me- keeping up with this place. With Pishlas. It's...refreshing, I think.
The Scarred Springs#128.dst: 这种感觉……像是卸下了心头的重担，同时也知道前面有新的任务在等我——维护这个地方。维护 Pishlas。这……让人神清气爽，我想。
The Scarred Springs#128.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#129.src: Do... I know you're just a tourist, but...do you think... Do you think my grandparents would be proud of me? For all this?
The Scarred Springs#129.dst: 你……我知道你只是个游客，但是……你觉得……你觉得我爷爷奶奶会为我感到骄傲吗？为了这一切？
The Scarred Springs#129.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#131.src: ...oh gosh, I promised myself I wouldn't cry...a-and here I am doing it anyways. Haha... Stars, I'm tired after all this. So, so tired...but. But the good king of tired, you know?
The Scarred Springs#131.dst: ……噢天啊，我答应过自己不哭的……可、可我还是哭了。哈哈……天哪，忙完这一切我好累。好累好累……但是。但是是那种好的累，你懂吗？
The Scarred Springs#131.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#132.src: You might need to go home soon, since you're just visiting...but come back any time. It'll be free, for you- and these should go pretty far in the {p}, I think. I just- Thank you...so much.
The Scarred Springs#132.dst: 你只是来玩的，可能很快就要回家了……不过随时欢迎回来。对你免费——而且我想这些在 {p} 应该挺值钱的。我只是——谢谢你……真的非常谢谢你。
The Scarred Springs#132.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#133.src: ...you know...you might have a point. I've been so weighed down by what everyone might think, that I could barely focus on the work. I should try and let that go, shouldn't I?
The Scarred Springs#133.dst: ……你知道吗……你说的可能有道理。我一直被别人会怎么想压得喘不过气，几乎没法专心工作。我应该试着放下，对吧？
The Scarred Springs#133.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#134.src: You know, for a tourist, you sure are generous with the help. So, I should be generous too! How's free access for life...and a personal gift from me sound? Again...thank you, so much!
The Scarred Springs#134.dst: 你知道吗，作为一个游客，你帮起忙来可真大方。所以，我也该大方一点！终身免费入场……再加上我个人送你的礼物，怎么样？再说一次……真的非常谢谢你！
The Scarred Springs#134.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#135.src: ...heh. I guess that would make sense. But...I'd like to think they would be. I really would.
The Scarred Springs#135.dst: ……嘿。我想那也说得通。不过……我愿意相信他们会的。真的愿意。
The Scarred Springs#135.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#136.src: So... For one thing. You get free access! For another...here's a personal gift from me! After all, you didn't HAVE to help...but you did! You'll get a lot more use out of these than I will. SO...thank you, so much!
The Scarred Springs#136.dst: 所以……首先。你可以免费入场！其次……这是我个人送你的礼物！毕竟，你不是非帮不可……但你帮了！这些你用得上的地方比我多得多。所以……真的非常谢谢你！
The Scarred Springs#136.speaker: Maripe
